question: Which of the following is NOT a function of money?
solution:
The correct sentence is "**Price stability**". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Keeping ***prices stable*** is one of the fundamental objectives of monetary policy.
 
• An ***economy*** that exhibits price stability has an overall price level that does not shift noticeably over time.
 
• The*** three purposes*** or services that money fulfills are frequently used as its definition.
 
• A ***unit of account***,*** a store of value***, and ***a medium of exchange ***are all functions performed by money.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• ***Store of value:***

 
 
• ​Money needs to be a store of value in order to maintain its value over time and function as a medium of*** trade***.
 
• If money couldn't be kept in a vault for a while and still be ***worth something*** in trade.
 
 
 
• ***Medium of exchange:***
 
 
• ​The primary purpose of money is to serve as a medium of exchange for*** transactions***.
 
 
 
• ***Unit of account:***
 
 
• ​The ***value of the goods ***and ***services being exchanged ***can be measured consistently using money as a unit of account.
 
 

9b:T
